verdict.rationale: Secureframe documents continuous daily monitoring with alerts for failing tests. Automated control testing pulls evidence from 100+ integrated systems, and admins get proactive email notifications when tests fail or change status. Failing tests also appear in an in-app dashboard, and misconfigurations are detected across the stack. Missing for 10: documented cadence is daily rather than an explicit hours-level detection interval, and there is no independent or hands-on corroboration of test frequency or alert latency.
